doc.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026

title: Embouchure exercises from Carmine Caruso and playing with Nat Junior
summary: Parsons learned Caruso exercises from a friend, used them for Nat and his students, and has played with Nat Adderley Jr. for twenty years.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: Yeah, because I was very much into learning about my embouchure, about how embouchure development is, and I had a buddy who, a close friend with this amazing range and I wanted to learn from him how he got it and he showed me the exercises from Carmine Caruso, ‘cause he studied with him for a long time. So I got, really, the benefit of Caruso training but without ever knowing Mr. Caruso.
You know and I gave the stuff to Nat and it worked. And I used the same stuff with all of my students. I’ve fixed many embouchures.
Oh, and you’ve played with Nat Junior?
Over the past twenty years or so.
